value.rationale: A complete prime spectrum of adjacent divisibility peaks/valleys of a natural ternary-tree counting sequence, including five exceptional primes, an asymmetric unique valley prime, sharp index densities and nontrivial two-flank correlations. Unlike individual or block valuations, these are natural local order invariants unavailable from one-point histograms. Not an arbitrary numeric slice or routine single congruence.
